name: High Cell Temperature
description: One or more battery cells exceeded the operating temperature threshold (>55°C).
corrective_action: Check ambient temperature and ventilation around battery cabinet. Reduce charge/discharge rate until cell temperatures normalize below 45°C.

name: Low Cell Temperature
description: Battery cells are below recommended charging temperature (<0°C).
corrective_action: Charge current is automatically restricted by BMS until internal heating elements or ambient temperature brings cells above 5°C.

name: Overvoltage Protection
description: Total battery pack voltage or individual cell voltage exceeded safety cutoff threshold.
corrective_action: Charging has been automatically interrupted by BMS. Verify grid inverter charge voltage settings and contactor operation.

name: Undervoltage Protection
description: Total battery pack voltage or cell voltage dropped below critical minimum discharge limit.
corrective_action: Discharging halted. Reconnect grid power to initiate maintenance trickle charge immediately to prevent permanent cell degradation.

name: Charge Overcurrent
description: Inflowing charge current exceeded maximum hardware rating.
corrective_action: Inspect inverter charge power limits and verify current sensor calibration.

name: Discharge Overcurrent
description: Outflowing discharge current exceeded maximum continuous discharge threshold.
corrective_action: Reduce connected AC load. Verify external circuit breaker and cable sizing.

name: High Cell Voltage Spread
description: Cell voltage delta between highest and lowest cell exceeds 80 mV.
corrective_action: Allow battery system to remain in float charging state to complete active/passive cell balancing cycle.

name: Insulation Resistance Abnormal
description: Isolation resistance between DC high-voltage bus and chassis ground is below 500 kΩ.
corrective_action: DANGER: High voltage leak detected. De-energize system, disconnect RS485 and inspect cable insulation and moisture in enclosure.

name: Internal Communication Fault
description: Master BMS lost internal CAN communication with subordinate module 1 or 2.
corrective_action: Check internal inter-module ribbon cabling and grounding between battery packs.

name: Contactor Drive / Welding Fault
description: Main DC contactor feedback auxiliary contacts do not match commanded drive state.
corrective_action: Main contactor may be welded or auxiliary switch failed. Do not attempt manual close. Service technician replacement required.

name: Precharge Failure
description: DC bus voltage failed to reach 90% of pack voltage during precharge timeout.
corrective_action: Check precharge resistor and check for external short circuit on DC bus output terminals.
